note: A UNESCO-IICBA tender of 14 May 2026, funded through GPE-KIX. For Eswatini it commissions a two-day national workshop on data use and inter-ministerial collaboration for about 50 senior officials, and says only that education data is more available through EMIS and related administrative systems: it does not say what the system does, who enters data or in which schools. The DHIS2 platform and the district data entry it describes are Lesotho's.
